digest.component_or_area: environment variable registry and configuration ownership
propositions: The prefix field in KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS tuples is unused, as all 9 live rows declare an empty prefix and the only historical prefixed user was removed by the RP-04 cutover
The prefix application code remains live in _scan_call and _helper_access but has zero production users and zero end-to-end coverage, creating a silent maintenance hazard
Remove the prefix field from KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS in both gen_env_registry.py and check_config_ownership.py, converting the table from dict[str, tuple] to dict[str, int]
Update all consumers of KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS to read bare integers instead of tuple subscripts and remove prefix concatenation logic
Update tests that reference the tuple shape to work with bare integers instead of (position, prefix) tuples
